payload.in_their_words: It's thorough. I now know the marriage will count at home. But it's written for the kids filling in forms, not for the person writing the cheques. And when a company tells me to 'ask whether it receives anything from partners', I wonder why it didn't simply say. No name, no face, and not a word about Mum and her walking frame.

findings.quote: Ask how the service is paid, and whether it receives anything from the partners it recommends.
findings.issue: Cost fear only touched: no total, wide town hall range, no concierge fee, commission question pushed back to the reader.
